title: One Ship as FleetLedger sees it (ship-fleet ls --json entries, status --json; version 1)
description: Each entry of `ship-fleet ls --json` (a list, one per Ship in the inventory, in its order) and the document `ship-fleet status NAME --json` prints. `ls --offline` builds it from each Ship's last fetched status and asks no Ship. See contracts/ship-fleet.md.

tags.description: Its tags in the inventory (defaults.tags counting).

state.description: The status document's state when there is one; not-enrolled: in the inventory, never enrolled, and not answering; else the problem; provisioning: only cloud-init answered.

problem.description: Why there is no status: unreachable, host-key (it answered with another host key), identity (it says it is another Ship), invalid (its status breaks the contract), error (ship-ctl failed), unknown (offline, and no status was ever fetched).

message.description: The problem in words; null when there is none.

host.description: The name it answered on; null offline or when nothing answered.

attention.description: The Ship's own attention items and FleetLedger's about it (signin-wrong-account, behind-tooling, tags-differ, host-cert-missing, ssh-trust-behind; offline: signin-wrong-account and tags-differ only). ship-fleet attention ranks them with the fleet's.

status.description: The Ship's status document (ship-status.schema.json): just fetched, or with --offline the last one fetched. null when there is a problem or only cloud-init answered.

cloud_init.description: cloud-init's own status JSON, when ship-ctl is not installed yet; null otherwise.
